AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Trusted registry document identifying an application administrator.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was recorded.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Public-safe member profile for Mega Achados 027 (PII isolated in private subcollection).

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Member display name shown in the header.

role.description: Account access role (members cannot self-assign admin).

preferredCategories.description: Up to 8 preferred promotion categories chosen by the user.

UserPrivateInfo.title: UserPrivateInfo
UserPrivateInfo.description: Isolated PII document storing user email and photo URL.

SavedDeal.title: SavedDeal
SavedDeal.description: A product or travel promotion bookmarked by a signed-in user.

id.description: Deterministic deal identifier matching the document ID.

dealType.description: Whether the saved offer is a product or a flight.

WhatsappForwarderSettings.title: WhatsappForwarderSettings
WhatsappForwarderSettings.description: Admin-managed WhatsApp sender number used as the official message forwarder for opted-in members.

senderPhone.description: Admin WhatsApp forwarder phone number in E.164 format (e.g., +5527998427710).

senderDisplayName.description: Display name shown to customers for the official WhatsApp sender.

enabled.description: Whether the WhatsApp forwarder is active for customer opt-in.

welcomeMessage.description: Optional welcome message prefilled when customers confirm their opt-in.

groupName.description: Official WhatsApp group name where all site promotions are automatically forwarded.

groupInviteUrl.description: Official WhatsApp group invite link (https://chat.whatsapp.com/...) for members to receive all deals.

autoForwardAllDealsToGroup.description: Whether every promotion announced on the site is automatically forwarded to the WhatsApp group.

updatedByUid.description: Admin UID who last updated the forwarder settings.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update.

WhatsappSubscriber.title: WhatsappSubscriber
WhatsappSubscriber.description: PII-isolated customer WhatsApp phone binding linked to their account to receive private alerts ONLY for chosen products.

uid.description: Owner Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Customer display name for personalized forwarding.

phoneNumber.description: Customer WhatsApp phone number in E.164 format (PII).

optIn.description: Whether the customer has actively enabled receiving private WhatsApp messages.

receiveProducts.description: Whether the customer wants private product alerts for their chosen products.

receiveFlights.description: Whether the customer wants flight deals.

selectedProducts.description: Up to 20 specific product names or keywords chosen by the customer to receive privately on WhatsApp.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when phone was first linked.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last subscription update.

/users/{userId}.description: Public-safe user profiles and promotion preferences.

/users/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: Isolated PII subcollection (document id 'info') restricted to owner or admin.

/users/{userId}/savedDeals/{dealId}.description: Saved favorite product and travel promotions per user.

/whatsappSettings/{docId}.description: Admin-managed WhatsApp forwarder sender configuration (document id 'forwarder').

/whatsappSubscribers/{userId}.description: PII-isolated customer WhatsApp phone links (owner self-service + admin forwarding access).
